title: Factorization of the specified refinement restriction component
statement: For every M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (R.ring X)), refinementRestriction R r hi M equals the hom component of refinementPull R r hi at the r.hom-direct-image of the c.i-extension, followed by the pullback along c.i of the proper derived counit for r.hom at that extension.

mathlib_searches.results: The exact factorization is the defining equation of refinementRestriction; no separate existing theorem was found.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Split as a small definitional factorization statement.

from.place: Factorization of the specified component before the clopen counit argument.

proof.text: Use the existing defining equation of refinementRestriction; the displayed equality is exactly refinementRestriction.eq_def.

lean.statement: theorem refinementRestriction_factorization (M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (R.ring X))) : refinementRestriction R r hi M = (refinementPull R r hi).hom.app ((push R r.hom).obj ((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj M)) ≫ (pull R c.i).map ((proEtaleRingDerivedAdjunction r.hom (R.ring d.Z) (R.ring c.Z) (R.pull r.hom)).counit.app ((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj M))
